text:
sophie: Quick sync — kicking off a thread to align on pilot panel curation for the Private launch. Goal: recruit 8-12 pilot partners across different verticals and maturity levels. Who can help source?

alex: I can ping 3 early customers (payments, retail, health). Two were open to pilot conversations last quarter. @kiran @elaine — want me to intro? :+1:

kiran: Please do the intros but let's lock the asks first. We should be explicit about telemetry, data controls, and what we need from them.

tj: Draft of core asks (short):
- 6-week pilot window
- weekly syncs + 1 end-of-pilot readout
- share sample prompt sets + pre/post metrics
- opt-in telemetry (token counts, latencies, error rates)
- NDA / data handling agreement

sophie: Add: dedicated support hours (overlap window) and access to a console view for the pilot. Proposed success metrics: 
- reliability: 90% of inference calls <200ms
- cost: >=15% token-cost improvement vs baseline/previous model
- quality: >=80% pass rate on 3 validated flows (customer-defined)

darren-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/priv-pilot-panel (permissions: product, solutions).

elaine: Screening criteria rough draft:
```
- production workload or pre-prod with real traffic (>=100k tokens/mo)
- requires data residency or stronger access controls
- clear operator (1x SWE + 1x PM) to participate in weekly syncs
- willingness to share perf/cost telemetry under NDA
```

alex: Here's a one-line outreach script we could A/B test: 
"Hi [Name], we’re running a 6-week pilot of Redwood Private focused on latency and cost improvements — dedicated support, telemetry, and clear success metrics. Would you be interested in learning more?"

kiran: Suggest tweak: call out data controls and opt-in telemetry explicitly. Also include a Calendly link in outreach. Keep it <=2 sentences.

sophie: Action items from this thread:
1) alex: send outreach to 3 contacts by Fri (include Calendly + one-pager).
2) kiran & elaine: prepare a one-pager with asks, telemetry, and NDA summary by Wed.
3) tj: draft evaluation rubric + dashboard templates (metrics + pass/fail thresholds) by next Tue.

alex: ack — will send a test message to the thread later today and post the responses.

sophie: If we don't hit the right mixture of verticals, fallback: expand to partners/integrators list and ISV partners. Also consider a small incentive (credits).

maria-marketing: We can amplify via partner newsletter + partner Slack channel. I’ll prepare a templated 1-pager and a short email version for outreach.

sophie: Thanks all — reconvene Thurs 10:00am to review intros and the one-pager. :calendar: 

(End of thread)
